How often the BD1 set spawns in military lockers and storage: jacket, pants, sneakers, gloves, warbelt with holster, LV-119 light plate carrier and its pouches.
How often the BD2 set spawns: combat shirt, pants, boots, gloves, warbelt with holster, drop-leg pouch, wrist GPS, FCPC V5 plate carrier and its pouches, 2 Day Assault Pack.
How often the BD3 set spawns: hooded jacket, pants, boots, fingerless gloves, warbelt with holster, LV-119 plate carrier and its pouches, NICE Frame backpack.

How often the BD4 set spawns: hybrid jacket, pants with knee pads, boots, gloves, battle belt, drop-leg holster and pouches, tactical watch, Siege-R plate carrier and its pouches, Modular Pack 45 backpack.
How often the head gear spawns: helmets, headsets, glasses, balaclavas, the M53A1 gas mask and the night vision goggles.
translate_en|mods/BlackDivisionGearTomb/: Add-on for Black Division Combat Gear on Tomb's Player Body: the gloves are drawn for Tomb's hands with separate fingers.
